headline: Stable Performance Supports Medium-term Growth Visibility; AI-led Transformation Progresses

highlights: In USD terms it reported growth of 1.8% QoQ and 3.5% YoY in revenues at USD 67.4 Mn (vs CIE estimate of USD 67.9 Mn). ▪ EBIT came in at INR 978.1 Mn, up 3.0% QoQ and 27.9% YoY (vs CIE estimate of INR 968.9 Mn).

EBIT margin came in at 15.2% for Q2FY27, up 4 bps QoQ and 182 bps YoY (vs CIE estimate of 14.9%). ▪ PAT for the quarter came in at INR 621.9 Mn, down by 8.0% QoQ and up 15.1% YoY (vs CIE estimate of INR 677 Mn).

Revenue Grows and Margin Expands Driven by AI-led Transformation: HAPPSTMN reported Q2FY27 revenue increased 2.7% QoQ/12.5% YoY to INR 6,450 Mn (2.4% QoQ/6.0% YoY CC), with EBIT margin came in at 15.2% up 4 bps QoQ, supported by higher utilisation (81.8%), IP-led revenues (10.5%) and operational efficiencies.
BFSI (+5.2% QoQ) remained the largest vertical (~28% of revenue), a strong growth in Retail & CPG (+11.0%), High-Tech (+4.3%) and Industrial (+5.3%).
valuation: The management reiterated FY27 revenue growth guidance of 12.5% and USD-1 Bn FY28 revenue target.
The proposed ITC Infotech merger, targeting a USD 1 Bn revenue business by FY28, is another key strategic development.
At the current valuation of 18x average FY28–29E earnings, we believe the risk- reward remains constructive.
